name: fleet-availability-eligibility
objective: Unify Captain availability, service mode, service-area/capacity eligibility and partner-fleet memberships on authoritative DSH state.
truthOwner: DSH owns Captain dispatch readiness, availability/service-area eligibility and partner-fleet membership; Identity only authenticates.

tasks.objective: Verify and complete partner-fleet membership lifecycle
tasks.currentProblem: Product Truth requires one-time code redemption, own membership list/disconnect, partner lifecycle visibility and redacted operator readback with optimistic versioning and audit.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace PartnerFleetConnectionCard through shared API/backend/database/operator panel; repair missing state, isolation, expiry, versioning, notification or readback behavior without creating local fleet truth.
tasks.targetState: Partner, Captain and operator observe one versioned DSH membership lifecycle; secret code material is single-use/digest-only and never leaked.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not persist plaintext connection codes.
Do not let operator mutate membership through a read-only panel.
Do not allow cross-store or cross-Captain membership access.
acceptanceCriteria: Captain can redeem only valid owned-context code and can list/disconnect only own memberships.
Partner and operator readbacks show authoritative lifecycle with redaction.
Expiry/revoke/disconnect are durable, versioned, audited and notified.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U003 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.

tasks.currentProblem: Dispatch Product Truth requires approved, available, service-area-bound Captain with remaining capacity; UI must not calculate final eligibility.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Captain availability/service mode/GPS readiness and operator service-area/capacity configuration into backend candidate selection and readiness readback.
tasks.targetState: Eligibility is server-owned, concurrency-safe and visible to Captain/operator without duplicating calculation in frontend.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned authoritative path first; implement at the truth owner, migrate only proven Captain-specific consumers/readbacks, remove obsolete parallel behavior when safe, then rerun linked checks on the final candidate.
mustNotChange: Do not make client-side distance/capacity checks authoritative.
Do not pull client-address/privacy mutation into Captain scope.
Do not permit stale availability to override backend readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Unavailable/ineligible Captain is not offered new work.
Service-area/capacity checks are enforced atomically where assignments are created.
Captain/operator see consistent readiness reason codes and recovery.

tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U003 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.
